# MeshHeal AI — Policy Simulation

*Generated by results_policy.py*

## Setup

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Folds | 8 (same LOEO splits, seeds, config as loeo_eval.py) |
| GNN seeds | [42, 7, 13, 99, 2024] |
| GNN config | hidden=16, LeakyReLU(0.1), Adam lr=0.01, epochs=100, pos_weight=1.0 |
| Collapse rule | prob_std < 0.01 → seed skipped |
| Normal holdout total | 137 snapshots |
| Holdout first half (calibration) | 68 snapshots |
| Holdout second half (FPR eval) | 69 snapshots |
| Threshold rule | 95th percentile of scores over all node-readings in first half |
| Policy | Top node must be > threshold AND was top+above-thresh in ≥3 of last 4 snaps |

> The second half of the holdout is used **only** to measure false-action rate; it is never used to set any threshold or tune any parameter.

## Assumptions, Deviations, and Items Not Run

1. **Threshold calibration.** 95th percentile of scores over all 4-node readings in the first 68 holdout snapshots (= 272 node-readings).
2. **Policy state continuity.** 3-of-4 history reset at start of each fold. Steady graphs processed chronologically. History then continues into h2 holdout eval.
3. **OUT_LAT_IDX=3.** Culprit score assumption. **not tested** against live data.
4. **GNN threshold per seed.** Each seed's model gets its own 95th-pct threshold.
5. **Steady snapshots.** phase='steady', correct episode_id, within test window.
6. **Confounded 6-fold controls.** Item 5 from the task (clean Oct-18 6-fold policy) is **not run**; the 8-fold policy above already covers all episodes.
7. **results_controls.md.** Culprit-score raw-latency variant: not tested here; see Control 1 in results_controls.md.
8. **Statistical significance.** Not tested. ~13-14 steady snapshots per fold.
